A1/023 · PN2070 to CPU AI0 analog scaling reference
CPU 1212C AI0 / X11:2 · 0–10 V rated range · raw value 0–27648 (Siemens Table A-41).
CPU analog input impedance ≥100 kΩ; PN2070 OUT2 voltage output minimum load ≥2 kΩ.
Configure B2 OUT2 to voltage (ou2 = U); verify the active ASP2 / AEP2 endpoints and output span at the device.
For the rated CPU range: normalized input = AI0raw / 27648, where 0 V → 0 and 10 V → 27648.
Conditional pressure relation for a verified 0–10 V span: P = ASP2 + (AI0raw / 27648) × (AEP2 − ASP2).
Siemens describes normalizing then scaling analog values; use NORM_X / SCALE_X or an equivalent validated implementation.
CPU 1212C AI: 10-bit resolution; stated accuracy 3.0% FS at 25 °C / 3.5% FS over −20…60 °C; no uncertainty budget is assigned.
No active PLC block, process point, ASP2/AEP2 values, calibration, alarms, or commissioned pressure scale is defined by this reference.
Sources: Siemens S7-1200 System Manual V4.7, Table A-41 and §6.3; ifm PN2070 data sheet / programming guide.

A1/025 · PN2070 / CPU AI0 conditional accuracy reference
Conditional 0–400 bar case only: verify OUT2 = U, ASP2 = 0 bar and AEP2 = 400 bar; CPU AI0 is 0–10 V.
ifm PN2070 characteristic deviation at limit setting, 1:1 span: <±0.5% → <±2 bar over 400 bar.
Siemens CPU 1212C AI accuracy: 3.0% FS at 25 °C / 3.5% FS over −20…60 °C → ±12 / ±14 bar.
Arithmetic sum of those stated contributions: <±14 bar at 25 °C; <±16 bar over the CPU temperature range.
This is a conditional partial error stack, not a complete uncertainty budget, measured result or accuracy guarantee.
Other sensor deviations, calibration, wiring noise, installation effects and any actual ASP2/AEP2 values are not included.
Confirm sensor mode, endpoints, CPU range and temperature before applying the conversion; no live setting is assumed.
Sources: ifm PN2070-02 data sheet, Accuracy / deviations; Siemens S7-1200 System Manual V4.7, Table A-41.
A1/026 · CPU 1212C AI0 idealized resolution reference
Conditional illustration only: verify PN2070 OUT2 = U and a linear 0–400 bar / 0–10 V span; CPU AI0 is rated 0–10 V.
Siemens CPU 1212C Table A-41 specifies 10-bit analog-input resolution over the 0–10 V rated range.
Ideal uniform code interval: 10 V / 2^10 = 9.765625 mV; mapped 400 bar / 2^10 = 0.390625 bar per interval.
Ideal rounding quantization alone would be ±0.1953125 bar (half an interval); this is derived, not a Siemens accuracy specification.
The 0–27648 PLC data-word scaling is a representation of rated full scale; it does not imply 15-bit analog resolution.
This idealization excludes effective resolution, noise, smoothing configuration, sensor deviation, calibration and field measurements.
The ideal half-step is much smaller than the CPU's published ±14 bar full-scale accuracy contribution over its rated temperature range.
Source: Siemens S7-1200 System Manual V4.7 (12/2024), CPU 1212C Table A-41.
A1/027 · CPU 1212C AI0 response and smoothing reference
Siemens Table A-42 gives built-in CPU analog-input 0–10 V step response measured at 95%; no smoothing setting is selected here.
Sample time by rejection frequency: 60 Hz → 4.17 ms; 50 Hz → 5 ms; 10 Hz → 25 ms (Table A-43).
95% step response · None (1 cycle; no averaging): 50 ms at 60 Hz; 50 ms at 50 Hz; 100 ms at 10 Hz rejection.
Weak smoothing (4 samples): 60 ms at 60 Hz; 70 ms at 50 Hz; 200 ms at 10 Hz rejection.
Medium smoothing (16 samples): 200 ms at 60 Hz; 240 ms at 50 Hz; 1,150 ms at 10 Hz rejection.
Strong smoothing (32 samples): 400 ms at 60 Hz; 480 ms at 50 Hz; 2,300 ms at 10 Hz rejection.
These are CPU input figures; sensor response, PLC scan, configured rejection and end-to-end system response are not established.
The project's rejection frequency and smoothing selection remain unassigned; no timing or filtering behavior is simulated.
Source: Siemens S7-1200 System Manual V4.7 (12/2024), CPU 1212C Tables A-42/A-43.
